about: Excerpt of GitHub's own record of the push that delivered the original private commit. Fields left out on purpose: the previous commit's hash (it names an unrelated private commit) and the account's avatar and profile URLs.
source: GitHub REST API, repository activity, GET /repos/kfkchau/gov-os/activity?activity_type=push&ref=refs/heads/main (private repository; the full record is visible only to the repository owner)
